question: On Passage — Smithsonian American Women’s History Museum Act (H R 1329)
bill_title: Smithsonian American Women’s History Museum Act
plain_language: This bill authorizes the Smithsonian American Women's History Museum to be located on a particular site within the Reserve of the National Mall in Washington, DC. A Yea supports passing it in the House; a Nay opposes it.

question: On Motion to Recommit — Smithsonian American Women’s History Museum Act (H R 1329)
bill_title: Smithsonian American Women’s History Museum Act
plain_language: H.R. 1329 (Smithsonian American Women’s History Museum Act) authorizes the Smithsonian American Women's History Museum to be located on a particular site within the Reserve of the National Mall in Washington, DC. A motion to recommit is the minority's last formal chance to send a bill back to committee before the passage vote. A Yea supports sending it back; a Nay keeps it on the floor for the passage vote.
